predecessors.name: Sultanate of Rum
predecessors.text: the Beyşehir lakeland, a frontier carved out of the declining Seljuk Sultanate of Rum

successors.name: Ilkhanate
successors.text: Beyşehir and the Eshrefid lands, taken by the Ilkhanid viceroy Timurtash in October 1326

ledger.x: 1280: Suleiman I ibn Eshref founds the Eshrefid principality at Beyşehir.
1326: the Ilkhanid viceroy Timurtash takes Beyşehir and ends the Eshrefids.

wars.name: Timurtash's conquest of the Eshrefids
wars.outcome: Ilkhanid victory: Timurtash captured Beyşehir and had the last bey, Suleiman II, drowned in the lake on 9 October 1326.

certainty.note: A small frontier principality in the Lakes region of Anatolia; no page gives a boundary, so the whole life is drawn soft.
